content: Overfitting in algo trading strategy generators: occurs when apparent edge is random noise not repeatable behavior. Excessive parameter optimization increases curve-fitting risk (more params = more combos that yield spurious great backtests). Reusing same data for build+validate creates false confidence. Warning signs: deterioration out-of-sample, brittle param values (small changes cause large output jumps), reliance on single regime/volatility state, excessive conditional logic/exceptions, suspicious smoothness that vanishes forward. Prevention: train/validate/test split, walk-forward analysis instead of single fixed backtest, cross-validation stress tests, true out-of-sample holdout.
